snippet.title: Cordura - Official Developer Overview Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Here's a look at the Developer Overview Trailer for Cordura, a 4-player online co-op psychological horror game developed by Garage51. Players will venture together into shifting procedural Victorian labyrinths where the environment is never the same. Lose your sanity, and the Night will mimic your team to feed your paranoia. Extract and survive. Cordura is coming soon to PlayStation and PC (Steam).

#IGN #Gaming
